name: gitswitch-wizard
description: GitSwitch Wizard — multi-GitHub account manager installer & updater. Installs, updates and manages GitSwitch without touching SSH configs it doesn't own.

scripts.release:patch: npm test && npm version patch -m "chore(release): %s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm test && npm version minor -m "chore(release): %s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm test && npm version major -m "chore(release): %s" && git push --follow-tags

author: DonArtkins (https://github.com/DonArtkins)
